claims.claim: A University of Missouri astronomer leads a team of 130 researchers from 62 institutions on a NASA mission targeting the early universe.
claims.source_title: Astronomer leads global team on NASA mission to create unprecedented view of the early universe
claims.supporting_quote: A University of Missouri astronomer is leading a team of 130 researchers from 62 institutions—including NASA, the California Institute of Technology, Princeton University and Harvard University—on an ambitious mission to capture an unprecedented view of the early universe.

claims.claim: Hubble captured NGC 1827, an edge-on spiral galaxy 37 million light-years away, as part of a survey of 260 satellite galaxies.
claims.supporting_quote: This NASA Hubble Space Telescope image features the edge-on, intermediate spiral galaxy NGC 1827, located roughly 37 million light-years away in the constellation Columba, the Dove.

claims.claim: The 3D model of stellar nurseries was developed by Dr Brandt Gaches from the University of Duisburg-Essen and published in Astronomy & Astrophysics.
claims.source_title: New 3D model reveals how shadows reshape chemistry in stellar nurseries
claims.supporting_quote: How do young stars reshape the clouds from which they are born? A new high-resolution 3D model developed by an international team led by Dr Brandt Gaches from the University of Duisburg-Essen shows how the uneven structure of stellar nurseries creates shadows that alter their chemistry and influence the infrared emission observed by the James Webb Space Telescope.

claims.claim: The University of Florida plant experiment flew on Blue Origin New Shepard NS-26 on August 29, 2024 and was published in npj Microgravity.
claims.source_title: Plants shift gene activity within minutes of entering spaceflight, experiment reveals
claims.supporting_quote: Published in the journal npj Microgravity, the study reports the results of an experiment conducted by a UF astronaut during Blue Origin's New Shepard NS-26 flight on Aug. 29, 2024.
